title: cantinoa subrotunda
intro: Cantinoa subrotunda, commonly known as Brazilian mint, is a type of flowering plant in the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cantinoa subrotunda include its use as a treatment for digestive issues, colds, and coughs, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
